seo.title: Balloons & Confetti Birthday Invitation Maker – Printable
seo.description: Make a bright balloons-and-confetti birthday invitation with the name, date and place already on it. Download a 5×7 in print PDF or a phone-ready image.

intro: The balloons and confetti theme is the all-purpose party look: bright colors, floating balloons, scattered confetti and playful rounded lettering. It says "party" at a glance, which is why it works when you do not have a bigger theme in mind yet.

Enter the birthday person's name, the date and the place, and PiCraft sets them into the design with the name as the largest text. Print the 5×7 inch card for guests, or send the phone-sized image straight into the group chat.

bestFor.title: Parties without a set theme
bestFor.description: If the party is simply about cake, friends and games, this look fits without asking the guests to dress up or bring anything.

bestFor.title: Mixed-age guest lists
bestFor.description: The design is cheerful rather than childish or formal, so it suits a party where kids, parents and grandparents are all invited.

bestFor.title: Last-minute invitations
bestFor.description: When the date is a week away, a bright all-purpose card gets the message across quickly and needs no matching decorations.

designNotes.title: Use the age line for the fun part
designNotes.description: A phrase such as "is turning 4!" or "is 10 today!" adds personality and sits neatly under the large name on the card.

designNotes.title: Keep the date and time separate
designNotes.description: Put the day and month in the date field and the hours in the time field. Busy confetti backgrounds read best when each line is short.

designNotes.title: Pick one color for the party
designNotes.description: The artwork is colorful by design. Choose balloons, plates and a cake in one or two of the same colors to make the party feel planned.

designNotes.title: Generate twice and compare
designNotes.description: Every generation arranges the balloons and confetti differently. Make a second version and pick the one where the name and date stand out most.

A backyard party: set the place to "Our backyard, 22 Cedar Lane" and add "Bring a swimsuit" in the RSVP line
A class party invitation with the RSVP line "Reply to Ms. Lee by Friday"
A surprise party: write "Shh! It's a surprise" in the age field

faq.q: Is the balloons and confetti theme only for children?
faq.a: No. The look is bright and friendly rather than childish, so it also suits teens and casual adult parties. For a more grown-up feel, try the [elegant black and gold theme](/create/birthday-invitation-maker/elegant).

faq.q: Will the confetti make the text hard to read?
faq.a: The design keeps the text in clear areas and sets it well inside the card. Look at the result at a small size on your phone before you send it, and generate again if any line is hard to read.

faq.q: Can I change the balloon colors?
faq.a: Colors are chosen by the design for each generation, so you cannot pick them in the form. Generate again until you get a palette you like.

faq.q: What size does the card print at?
faq.a: The print file is 5×7 inches with a 0.125 inch bleed. See the [birthday invitation size guide](/sizes/birthday-invitation-size) for envelopes and home printing.

bestFor.title: Space and science fans

bestFor.title: Milestone birthdays

bestFor.description: The glamorous look fits venues such as a hotel lounge, a restaurant private room or a rooftop terrace.

bestFor.title: Surprise parties for adults

faq.q: Can I use this theme for a child's birthday?

faq.q: Can the card hide the person's age?
faq.a: Yes. The age or milestone field is optional. Leave it empty and the card shows only the name, date and place.

faq.q: How many invitations should I send?
faq.a: Count the guest list and add a few spares for late additions. Digital sending by message is an easy way to reach everyone without extra printing.

faq.q: Can I choose the colors?
faq.a: There is no color picker. Each generation picks a palette, so generate again until you find one you like.

faq.q: How does it compare with the floral theme?
faq.a: Watercolor splash is abstract and vivid, while [soft floral](/create/birthday-invitation-maker/floral) is gentle with blush and sage flowers. Pick floral for a quiet, traditional feel.

faq.q: What size is the print file?
faq.a: A 5×7 inch card with a 0.125 inch bleed at 300 DPI, plus a 1080×1500 px image for sharing.
